title: Postdoc Position in Quantum Control of Semiconductor Qubits
about: Postdoctoral position at QuTech, TU Delft, on quantum control of semiconductor qubits, listed on the TU Delft jobs board at 38-40 hours per week.
card_alt: Card for the Postdoc Position in Quantum Control of Semiconductor Qubits at QuTech, Delft University of Technology, Delft, Netherlands, deadline 15 Nov 2026. The photo shows colourful gabled canal houses and moored boats along a canal in Amsterdam, not Delft.
